title: Authenticated inbound events and relationship graphs
summary: SocialReference and SocialInteraction preserve scoped identities and parent-child links. The inbound gate verifies before graph insertion and rejects duplication.
invariants: Conversation edges are evidence about replies, not proof of identity, ownership or consent.
Live adapters must bind immutable raw provider-originated evidence to a normalized interaction; trusting mutable interaction metadata is insufficient.
Replay/dedup is scoped to stable provider/account/event identity; cannot infer that identical text equals an identical event.
No synthetic adapter authenticates inbound events.
